parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: Mid
parameters.description: The machine identifier (MID). You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudSdkServers](~~2982006~~) operation to query the hybrid cloud SDK list and obtain this value.

parameters.name: PullinStatus
parameters.description:
The traffic redirection status. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.
